dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Monitor connections, events, and redeems from every platform in one place.

interactionControl.title: Interactions
interactionControl.enabledDescription: Stream rules and tests can add interactions to the queue.
interactionControl.disabledDescription: Events are still recorded, but they do not create interactions or accumulate progress. Disabling clears everything pending.

liveEvents.title: Live Events
liveEvents.description: Choose an activity to configure it and follow its status during the live stream.
liveEvents.peskyBattleDescription: Recruit five participants and face their attacks for a full level.
liveEvents.tapFarmingDescription: Turn the whole community's taps into extra resistance that makes the boss last longer.

conflict.title: Another Live Event is already active
conflict.peskyBattleActive: Pesky Battle must finish before you can activate Tap Farming.
conflict.tapFarmingActive: Tap Farming must finish before you can arm Pesky Battle.

peskyBattle.title: Pesky Battle
peskyBattle.description: Recruit five participants with a specific gift and face their attacks for a full level. The roster stays intact if you lose and retry.

phaseDescription.off: Configure the gift and attacks before opening the five slots.
phaseDescription.recruiting: Each unique user who sends the gift will fill one slot.
phaseDescription.ready: All five slots are ready. The battle will start in the next level.
phaseDescription.waiting_level: Enter the next level to start the battle.
phaseDescription.waitingTarget: The battle is armed for the next level: {level}.
phaseDescription.active: Attempt {attempt}. If you lose, the same five participants will remain for the retry.
phaseDescription.won: You won the level. Attacks stopped and the roster remains visible until you start another battle.

trigger.label: Gift required to join
trigger.catalogError: The catalog could not be loaded
trigger.hint: A user can fill only one slot, even if they send the gift more than once.
trigger.locked: The gift is locked until you cancel or finish this battle.

streamAttacks.title: Allow live interaction attacks
streamAttacks.enabled: Live rules may continue launching attacks during this battle.
streamAttacks.disabled: All live rules are blocked while the battle is exclusive.

attacks.title: Battle attacks
attacks.description: Choose the independent pool used by the five participants.
attacks.locked: The pool is locked while the battle is armed.

roster.title: Participants
roster.description: The first five unique users who send the gift enter the battle.
roster.simulationHint: Gifts sent from Simulate event can also fill these slots; initials are shown when no photo is provided.

master.off: Interactions is disabled. Recruitment and the battle's own attacks still work.
master.streamAllowed: Live-rule attacks will continue arriving in addition to the battle.
master.streamBlocked: All live rules will be blocked during the battle without affecting its own attacks.

tapFarming.title: Tap Farming
tapFarming.description: The entire community's taps combine to increase the boss's health. The more taps they get, the longer the fight will last.

phaseDescription.off: Configure the tap-to-health equivalence and activate the event when the stream begins.
phaseDescription.collecting: Every tap is already being saved for the next boss.
phaseDescription.active: Shots drain the tap-created reserve before they continue damaging the boss.
phaseDescription.activeBoss: {boss} · Phase {phase} of {count}. The reserve drains without moving the boss backward.
phaseDescription.transition: New taps are banked while Cuphead prepares the next phase.
phaseDescription.completed: The boss was defeated. Review the result before closing this event.
phaseDescription.stopping: Finishing the round and releasing the Live Events slot.

conversion.description: Define how many taps increase the boss's health. Use an amount that is easy to explain to your audience.
conversion.hint: The equivalence is saved before activation and stays fixed for the whole round.
conversion.locked: The conversion is locked until this event ends.

progress.noBoss: Taps are accumulating from now on
progress.battle: Effective health remaining across the boss and reserve

progress.reserveEquivalent: The current reserve equals {value}× this boss's full health.
progress.reservePercent: The current reserve equals {value} of this boss's full health.
progress.converted: The community has converted {value} health points.

tapFarming.footer: Taps are pooled across every user; remainders also count toward the next conversion.

pesky.title: Pesky Mode
pesky.description: Adds random attacks from the interaction catalog during any fight, whether entered normally or through the roulette. You can also configure names to appear randomly with the attacks.
pesky.interactionsNotice: Interactions are enabled, so donation attacks will continue arriving in addition to this mode's attacks.
pesky.battleBlocked: Pesky Battle has exclusive control. Finish or cancel that battle before enabling the free mode again.

phaseProtection.title: Transition protection
phaseProtection.description: For the Devil, blocking starts 6 seconds after the phase 1 to 2 signal. For a full comparison, change it before the transformation; it turns back on when the game restarts.

queue.title: Mode queue
queue.description: Attacks appear up to the configured simultaneous limit. The rest wait in the order they were generated.
queue.emptyDescription: Enable Pesky Mode and enter a gameplay level to see generated attacks here.
queue.name: Name

names.title: Random names
names.description: Optional. Enter one name per line; blank lines and duplicates are removed, and each name may contain up to 32 characters. If you leave the list empty, attacks will appear without a name.
names.hint: One name is selected randomly for each attack.
names.emptyHint: No names: attacks will appear without a name.

attacks.description: Check the items that may appear. New catalog items will be enabled automatically.
